questions.question: Which action is locomotor?
Which action is nonlocomotor?
What does body alignment describe in dance?
choices: How body parts are organized in relation to one another

questions.question: Which choice is a level change?
choices: Moving from a crouch to a standing reach

questions.question: A dancer moves diagonally from upstage left to downstage right. What is changing?
What is balance in movement?
choices: Moving only in a straight line
Maintaining or controlling stability while still or moving

questions.question: A dancer shifts weight from the right foot to the left foot. Why is this transfer useful?
choices: It removes the need for alignment
It supports controlled movement and changes in balance or direction

questions.question: Which pathway is curvilinear?
choices: A straight route from one point to another
A series of sharp right-angle turns only
A rounded, looping route through space

questions.question: A dancer performs a turn while keeping the eyes focused on a fixed point as long as possible. What is this technique commonly called?
Why should a dancer bend the knees when landing from a jump?
choices: To increase impact on the joints
To absorb impact and support control
To stop the movement before landing

questions.question: A movement phrase repeats a reach but changes the level each time. What is being explored?
What is mirroring in dance?
choices: One dancer reflects another dancer's movements

questions.question: A dancer reaches high, then folds low, then extends sideways. Which element is especially visible?
What does a gesture communicate in dance?
choices: The number of dancers on stage
An expressive movement of part of the body

questions.question: A dancer's movement feels controlled and sustained. Which quality is most evident?
Why do dancers practice weight shifts slowly before performing them quickly?
choices: To remove the need for rehearsal
To build coordination, balance, and control

questions.question: Which option best describes a still shape in dance?
choices: A held body position that can communicate line, level, or balance

questions.question: What is a safe way to explore a new movement range?
choices: Force the body beyond a comfortable range
Increase range gradually while maintaining control and comfort

questions.question: A group forms a line, then a circle. What is changing?
Why can the same arm movement look different when performed sharply or smoothly?
choices: The choreography becomes a new genre
Energy quality changes the movement's expressive effect
